'''Beebe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who made his home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He worked as a trainer of his fellow hunters in the city of [[Sobrik]].
